argumentConfig: Create config file populated with defaults
tuiOnly: /context {view} is available in TUI mode only.
probeCompactionInProgress: Silent probe unavailable: context compaction is in progress.
probeNoModel: Silent probe unavailable: no model is selected.
probeNoAuth: Silent probe unavailable: {provider} has no configured authentication.
probeNoCapture: Silent probe did not capture Initial.
usageDescription: Estimated context for the next model request. Token counts are approximate and may differ from the provider's estimate.
invisibleReasoningDescription: Entry headers read: [DD-MM-YYYY] [assistant] visible + Reasoning ≈invisible (≈total). ≈ is a provider-reported count; ~ is a rough approximation when no breakdown is reported and excluded from category totals. Encoded replaces Reasoning when the provider replays encrypted reasoning with its message.
noContentCaptured: No content captured for this category.
injectionsDescription: Injections into the model context for the first turn, with token estimates.
markerHighlightedExplanation: parts are injected by extensions into pi’s system prompt. They are excluded from the System Prompt token count and included in the injecting extension’s count.
markerGuessExplanation: sources are inferred from the injected text itself.
markerDroppedExplanation: parts were replaced by a custom system prompt and are counted nowhere.
markerMovedExplanation: blocks appear in a different position in the system prompt than usual. Their token counts are unchanged.
